title: Scans to one searchable PDF
description: Drop the photos or scans of a paper document's pages, in order, and get one PDF with A4 pages whose text you can search, select and copy: Filee recognises the English text offline with Tesseract. Change the language in the preset (for example deu, fra or kor) for other documents. Saved as name_scan.pdf after the first page. Needs Tesseract (Engines page).
author: KnifeLemon
